newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai bourse says not consider repo abolition.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai bourse says not consider repo abolition.

text.p: The Shanghai stock exchange said on Friday it is not considering cancelling two short-term state debt repurchase contracts.

Widespread rumours saying the exchange would cancel the three-day and seven-day state debt repurchase contracts starting from next Monday were one of the factors depressing shares on the bourse on Friday, brokers said.
Asked about the rumours on the markets, a spokesman said: "I can't confirm the rumours. We are not considering (a cancellation). We have not considered (such a cancellation)."
Funds derived from trading the three-day and seven-day repurchase contracts are a major source of liquidity for China's stock markets.
At the end of the morning session, Shanghai's A share index was down 13.689 points or 1.17 percent to 1,154.777 points.
